title: Understanding Silhouette Score
text: The silhouette score measures how similar a data point is to its own cluster compared to other clusters. A negative silhouette score indicates that the point is closer to a neighboring cluster than to its own cluster.

title: Negative Silhouette Score
text: If a data point has a negative silhouette score, it means that the average distance to points in its own cluster is greater than the average distance to points in the nearest neighboring cluster.
